INVITE sip:[field0]@lab.sip SIP/2.0 Via: SIP/2.0/[transport] [local_ip]:[local_port];branch=[branch] Max-Forwards: 70 From: <sip:[service]@lab.sip>;tag=[pid]SIPpTag01[call_number] To: <sip:[field0]@lab.sip> Call-ID: [call_id] CSeq: 1 INVITE Contact: <sip:[service]@[local_ip]:[local_port]> User-Agent: sip-lab dialer Content-Type: application/sdp Content-Length: [len]
v=0 o=dialer 1001 1001 IN IP4 [local_ip] s=sip-lab c=IN IP4 [local_ip] t=0 0 m=audio [media_port] RTP/AVP 8 0 101 a=rtpmap:8 PCMA/8000 a=rtpmap:0 PCMU/8000 a=rtpmap:101 telephone-event/8000 a=fmtp:101 0-15 a=sendrecv
